name: LCI_HEDIS_PLAN
description: Clarity table for the HEDIS plan related items in LCI.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_CVG_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the external coverage record record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this contact. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this contact.

columns.name: HEDIS_PLAN_EFF_DATE
columns.description: The effective date for an NCQA HEDIS plan of an external coverage contact.

columns.name: HEDIS_PLAN_TERM_DATE
columns.description: The termination date for an NCQA HEDIS plan of an external coverage contact.

columns.name: HEDIS_PLAN_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The plan type for an NCQA HEDIS plan of an external coverage contact.
